description: Single QTB, no W-2 wages, taxable income about $259k before QBI — 2025 phase-in has ended, so the wage limit is fully applied (G10).
derivation: Profit $290,000. SE deduction ≈ $14,802. AGI ≈ $275,198. TI before QBI ≈ $259,448, which is above the 2025 end of $247,300 and would still be inside a leaked 2026 $75,000 range (ends $272,300). With $0 W-2 wages the 2025 full limit zeros the deduction. A 2026 range would have left a phase-in remainder.
